notes.title: A Bricky Christmas party!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Take part in our contests and win awesome prizes![/b][/h1]

[img]http://w3.cdn.brick-force.com/uploads/teaser/image_56702a1f5b220.jpeg?0c96a61e5d650[/img]


Reindeer, biscuits, mistletoe … the brick world lies in deep, cold snow!

Are you already looking forward to opening up your presents underneath the Christmas tree? Maybe this time there’ll be gifts for you in Brick-Force too!

It’s time for our Christmas contests, and here they are:


[h1][b]A Christmas-themed Map[/b][/h1]

Building experts, are you ready? This is your chance!

Create a map that brings the Christmas spirit upon us. This time, there are no specifications about the exact topic. No limits are placed on your creativity!

You can win up to [b]3 months of Premium membership[/b] and a [b]complete (fully upgraded) Santa costume[/b]!

Find out more [url=http://www.brick-force.com/forum/showthread.php/31492-A-Christmas-themed-Map][b]here[/b][/url]!


[h1][b]A kitschy heart-warming Christmas poem[/b][/h1]

Time to get into the Christmas mood by making up some gooey lines for a Christmas poem! To make it a bit more challenging, your rhymes have to contain specific terms.

The winners will be rewarded with up to [b]2000 Tokens[/b] and a [b]complete (fully upgraded) Rudolph costume[/b]!

Check out the contest details [url=http://www.brick-force.com/forum/showthread.php/31493-A-kitschy-heart-warming-Christmas-poem][b]here[/b][/url].


[h1][b]A Christmas greeting card[/b][/h1]

What would Christmas be without the lovely Christmas greeting cards that are sent out to friends and families? Design a front page of such a greeting card and share it with us. 

The 3 best entries will be rewarded with one [b]Shooting Star (fully upgraded)[/b] each!

Find out more [url=http://www.brick-force.com/forum/showthread.php/31494-A-Christmas-greeting-card][b]here[/b][/url] and take part in the contest.


[h1][b]Everyone is a winner[/b][/h1]

This time we’d like to ensure that nobody is left empty-handed. Therefore, everyone who participates in at least one of the three contests and meets all the requirements will be rewarded with [b]10 Pick ’N’ Win Coins[/b]!

notes.title: Halloween is upon us!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Take part in our Contests and win awesome Prizes![/b][/h1]

It’s that time of the year again – ghosts, witches and jack o’ lanterns are upon us!

In order to properly celebrate Halloween in Brick-Force and give each Brick-Forcer a right old scare, we are now launching the preparations for the scariest of all celebrations. To cover everybody’s taste, this time, we are offering you three different contests to take part in!


[url=www.brick-force.com/forum/showthread.php/31286-Contest-Create-a-Halloween-themed-Map][img]https://static3.brick-force.com/uploads/files/image-1.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Create a Halloween-themed Map[/h1]

This is for the building experts among you! Create a Halloween-themed map in one of the following two categories:

[list][*]Create a scary painting
[*]Build a scary ghost train[/list]

You can win up to [b]3 months of Premium membership[/b] and a [b]complete (fully upgraded) Halloween costume[/b]!

Find out more [b][url=www.brick-force.com/forum/showthread.php/31286-Contest-Create-a-Halloween-themed-Map]here[/url][/b]!


[url=www.brick-force.com/forum/showthread.php/31289-Contest-Tell-us-the-scariest-story-of-all-times!][img]https://static1.brick-force.com/uploads/files/image-3.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Tell us the scariest story of all times![/h1]

Do you think you have what it takes to write the most thrilling, creepy and scary Halloween story of all times? Then don’t wait any longer and start writing, because there’s a whole bunch of prizes waiting for you! You can win up to 1000 Tokens and a (fully upgraded) Halloween weapon.

Find out more [b][url=www.brick-force.com/forum/showthread.php/31289-Contest-Tell-us-the-scariest-story-of-all-times!]here[/url][/b] and take part in the contest.


[url=www.brick-force.com/forum/showthread.php/31292-Contest-Craft-a-Brick-Force-Halloween-Mask!][img]https://static4.brick-force.com/uploads/files/image-2.png[/img][/url]
	
[h1]Craft a Brick-Force Halloween Mask![/h1]

Grab some carton, paper and a few pens and create a scary Halloween-themed Brick-Force mask! The most creative people amongst you will be rewarded with Tokens, P’n’W Coins and a (fully upgraded) Halloween mask!

Check out the contest details [b][url=www.brick-force.com/forum/showthread.php/31292-Contest-Craft-a-Brick-Force-Halloween-Mask!]here[/url][/b].

__________________________________


All contests end on [b]27 October 2015[/b]. The winners will be announced the following day.

[b]Please note:[/b] You can take part in all 3 contests, but you can only win one of them.

Are you ready to turn Brick-Force into a world full of sinister creatures? We are looking forward to the shock of our lives!

notes.title: Map of the Week - Epixios by Monster878
notes.content:
[h1][b]A King’s Task[/b][/h1]

[img]https://static1.brick-force.com/uploads/teaser/image_55a541195ccc7.jpeg?0c96a61e5d650[/img]

[h1]The Map[/h1]

The Epixios cathedral stands as one of the great wonders of the Brick-World. It was said to be built thousands of years ago, by an extremely rich king. As a very religious man, he wanted to dedicate his life to serving his people, and his god. With that mission, he gathered up the best architects and engineers his kingdom could offer, as well as experts from other countries far away. Using their joint intellect, they designed the greatest complex they could imagine.

The result took nearly 100 years to complete. The king lived long enough to see the main cathedral reach up into the sky, and the flowing blue water bringing green life to the gardens surrounding it. The space underneath was then turned into a tomb fit for a king, and he and his family are now buried there. His grandson oversaw the completion of the surrounding towers and temples, and finally the project was complete.

[img]https://static4.brick-force.com/uploads/files/facebook_en.jpeg[/img]

Epixios was done, and it has survived the sands of time to stand here in modern times, and will likely stand for thousands of years longer.

[h1]The Challenge[/h1]

[b]Play 5 Matches[/b] in a mode of your choice on Epixios by Monster878 and earn yourself a [b]Fancy Justice (7 days)[/b]!

[b]End[/b]: Sunday, 19 July 2015, 23:59 CEST

notes.title: Map of the Week - Die Totale by sexy-tot
notes.content:
[h1][b]The floating city[/b][/h1]

[img]https://www.brick-force.com/uploads/teaser/image_559e6df50febe.jpeg[/img]

[h1]The Map[/h1]

Somewhere in the mists of the largest brick-ocean in Brickworld, lies an entirely new city built from scratch, which is unlike any other - this city floats. It’s called ‘Die Totale’, which is german for All-In-One. The german creator had learnt that boats and ships sailing this ocean often had terrible damage from storms, and no crew ever wanted to make the journey unless they had to. So he set out to tame that ocean!

[img]https://static3.brick-force.com/uploads/files/facebook_map_of_the_week-en.jpeg[/img]

He built a harbour smack dab in the middle for the biggest ships to load and unload their cargo, to get repairs. It also provided support from helicopters and seaplanes to reach out even further across the sea, and a small town for people to live there, as well as travellers to rest and have a nice break from their tough voyage. Sailors say that as long as they follow the bright light emitted from All-In-One’s hi-tech watchtower, they’ll make it across the ocean trouble-free.

[h1]The Challenge[/h1]

[b]Win 3 Matches[/b] in a mode of your choice on Die Totale by sexy-tot and earn yourself [b]2000 Force Points[/b]!

[b]End:[/b] Tuesday, 14 July 2015, 23:59 CEST

notes.title: Map of the Week - Rockscape by apple2018
notes.content:
[img]https://static3.brick-force.com/uploads/teaser/image_558181851e5ef.jpeg?d02b67fe5adb0[/img]

[h1][b]The Map[/b][/h1]

Once upon a time, there lived a small group of Brick people in a nameless valley. It was quite picturesque: A little river flowed through flower meadows, which were regularly flooded during autumn time; there was an abundance of everything, and the weather was always beautiful. But this paradisiac environment came at a high price. Every few decades, heavy earthquakes threatened the land. One after the next, the people left the valley until only very few were left.

[img]https://static1.brick-force.com/uploads/files/facebookEN.jpeg[/img]

When a particularly heavy earthquake had destroyed almost everything around them, the remaining inhabitants saw no other way but to leave their beloved home. They decided to venture alongside the few rocks that were left and to climb a steep hill, whose top was said to harbour a mysterious portal placed there eons ago by the gods. None, who had gone through ever returned, so it was shrouded in legend. But the brick people saw no other way and got ready to take the dangerous path up to the top. In order to honour their audacious mission, they named the remaining pieces of the valley “Rockscape”.

[h1][b]The Challenge[/b][/h1]

[b]Play 5 Matches[/b] in Escape Mode on Rockscape by apple2018 and earn yourself a [b]Fancy Lone Star (7 days)[/b]!

[b]End:[/b] Sunday, 21 June 2015, 23:59 CEST

notes.title: Map of the Week - Quechua by Badaboom5
notes.content:
[h1][b]Temple of Doom[/b][/h1]

[img]https://static1.brick-force.com/uploads/teaser/image_555b6ca46d3e4.jpeg?f844719e5895c[/img]

[h1]The Map[/h1]

Badaboom was on holiday with his family in Peru. Reluctantly, he went to visit the Incan city of Machu Picchu, which has stood there for 4000 years. He was fascinated, and wanted to stay and explore for hours, in particular the Incan temple, said to be a place of worship and sacrifice. Back in the hotel that night, Badaboom’s head was filled with questions and thoughts about the Incans. He fell into a fitful sleep.

Suddenly he was awake, woken by drums. He was in a paradise: waterfalls, palm trees, beautiful sunny sky. An Incan appeared before him, and motioned him to follow. He took Badaboom to the Incan temple, which was fully rebuilt and full of Incans bowing down to the middle of the room, where an animal sacrifice was taking place. Badaboom was so confused, but also transfixed by the sight.

[img]https://static2.brick-force.com/uploads/files/facebook_EN_2.jpeg[/img]

Out of nowhere, gunfire was heard, followed by screams. Badaboom knew what was happening, he remembered from the tour guide – The conquistadors had arrived. He picked up a spear to join the fight, when whiteness filled his vision. BEEP BEEP BEEP. He was back in his bed, and the sun was coming in through the blinds of his room. The crazy dream was over.

Now you get to decide how the battle would have turned out! Who will win, the native Incans and their bloody traditions, or the invading Spaniards, intent on looting everything in their path?

[h1]The Challenge[/h1]

Play 5 matches in a mode of your choice on Quechua by Badaboom5 and earn yourself [b]3 Medium Elite Equipment Gems[/b]!

[b]End:[/b] Sunday, 31st May 2015, 23:59 CEST

notes.title: Map of the Week - Aeropuerto by player-2
notes.content:
[h1][b]Lost in Time[/b][/h1]

[img]https://static2.brick-force.com/uploads/teaser/image_5552119b71706.jpeg?f844719e5895c[/img]

[h1]The Map[/h1]

When the Brickes family went on their annual holiday to Spain, they didn’t expect to be travelling so far….in time! All they wanted to do is relax by a beach with their brick-feet in the soft sand, now they’re fighting for their lives in the sandy Wild West, in the wooden saloons of the Spanish aeropuerto. If only they hadn’t met The Brick-Doctor.

[img]https://static1.brick-force.com/uploads/files/facebook_EN.jpeg[/img]

“Brick-Doctor who?” they asked. He didn’t reply, only waving them into his small Brick-box, and next thing they knew they were 200 years in the past. It doesn’t matter now, they have to escape an attack by native Indians, somewhere within the aeropuerto. That should give the Brick-Doctor enough time to clear his strange time-travelling box of sand, and get them out of here! This is one stressful holiday….

[h1]The Challenge[/h1]

[b]Play the map 6 times[/b] in a mode of your choice on Aeropuerto by Player-2 and earn yourself [b]3 Medium Elite Weapon Gems[/b]!

notes.title: Map of the Week - Yarucaras by RCP
notes.content:
[h1][b]Old Elf Lands[/b][/h1]

[img]http://w1.cdn.brick-force.com/uploads/teaser/image_55377d6d196c3.png?8b3c927e5863c[/img]

[h1]The Map[/h1]

Yarucaras was once a civilised city, where peace was valued as highly as the respect for nature. But as the city was very popular among the Brick People due to its beautiful flora and fauna, many of them moved there within a short timeframe. The bigger the city grew, the louder and dirtier it became, and soon, every last plant had been replaced with concrete.

One day though, huge trees started growing everywhere. People assumed that the old elven people that had once roamed these lands were still present in spirit and that this was their way of telling people to remember their old respect for nature.

Unfortunately, the people didn’t listen to the spirits and soon, the trees became a tourist attraction of their own. More than ever before, the city was groaning under the burden of all the people. Until one day, it all ended when a great earthquake shattered the lands and split the earth which swallowed all the remains of the now ruined city.

[img]https://static1.brick-force.com/uploads/files/facebook_EN_10.png[/img]

Today, the forests of Yarucaras are inhabited by a tribe of people who are said to be descendants of the old elves. Lately, some so-called civilised people have been trying to re-build the city here, but nothing good came from it – all it provoked was new battles breaking out constantly.

Will the tribe members manage to protect Yarucaras from the city people for the rest of time?

[h1]The Challenge[/h1]

Win 3 matches in a mode of your choice on Yarucaras by RCP and earn yourself an Orc Flower Pot (fully upgraded) (30 Days)!

This secluded house, aptly named Getaway for its remote location and calming scenery, is the home of a mysterious Brick-Millionaire, who has retired from active duty in the Brick-Force. He must have been someone quite important to afford such a nice retirement home!

Some say that he still couldn’t shake the decades of experience when building his house, and therefore added in plenty of extras…just in case. There’s rumours of secret labs, cave entrances and strategically placed, bulletproof trash cans in case of a home invasion.

[img]http://w4.cdn.brick-force.com/uploads/teaser/image_551d5d774e1b7.png?8f295cce57ed8[/img]

[h1]The Map[/h1]

After weeks of investigation, the special Brick-agent - 00B – has finally tracked down his arch-nemesis, the Evil Professor, and found the location of his secret lair. As he infiltrated the base however, the cunning professor had him captured, sent to be interrogated, and eventually killed in an incredibly elaborate way that he will probably escape from!

Activating the homing beacon hidden within his secret agent underwear, he signalled for reinforcements from MIBricks (His Brick-Majesty’s secret service). They must fight their way into the base, and have a shootout with the evil professor’s henchmen! They better watch out where they shoot though, the professor was stockpiling chemicals, weapons and explosives all over his base for his plan to take over the world.

[i]Will the MIBricks soldiers save the world, for Brick-King and country? Or will the henchmen win out, deal with 00B for good, and finally take over the world?[/i]

notes.title: Code Green by Razerzz
notes.content:
[img]https://static4.brick-force.com/uploads/teaser/image_551acd932a61d.png?b65693de557c3[/img]

[h1][b]The Map[/b][/h1]

It is a quiet evening in Brickcoon City. The only inhabitants who are still awake are scientists diligently working on their secret project – the B-Virus. Unbeknownst to the rest of the citizens, the Brickella Corporation are testing their new drug on live subjects who have been locked up in their labs. This drug should cause a spreadable virus which turns any human or animal into an uncontrollable, violent monster.

[img]https://static2.brick-force.com/uploads/files/EN.png[/img]

This evening, this became a reality for the Brickella Corporation. Unfortunately, the test subjects used their increased rage and strength to break free of their cages, and started to fight their way out of the facility. The remaining humans built barricades and traps to stop the infected, before it was too late, and they are released into the city.

As the poor souls infected with the B-Virus edge closer to freedom, the ‘Code Green’ alarm is called – the alert that signals an incoming zombie apocalypse…

[h1][b]The Challenge[/b][/h1]

Win 5 matches in a mode of your choice on Code Green by Razerzz and earn yourself the Evil Professor's Glasses (30 days)!

notes.title: Map of the Week - Suora
notes.content:
[h1][b]Suora by apple2018[/b][/h1]

[img]http://w4.cdn.brick-force.com/uploads/teaser/image_55118eed4c4b0.png?b65693de557c3[/img]

“Many years ago, the swamp ‘Suora’ was very lively and populated with many types of animals and plants.” The guide made a little pause and looked at the group of Brick-Tourists he was leading through nature. “Alas, today, this place is home to but a few plants and trees, while all fauna has completely abandoned it. After a drought had changed the land permanently, the people started hunting anything that lived here and eventually, either wiped out entire species or drove them out of this land. Not even fish now live in the clear ponds surrounding the swamp.”

[img]https://static4.brick-force.com/uploads/files/facebook_EN_8.png[/img]

The guide cleared his throat and paused again. After some hesitation, he continued: “There is a myth saying that the swamp is now home to a special type of bees, whose stings will completely cloud peoples’ minds. The infected are said to attack everyone around them … Well, if you ask me, this is just a fairy tale. After all, bees are animals, too, and all animals that once lived here were killed or driven out. Anyway, we should head on to our next attraction, which is only about 20,000 Bricks west of here.” Suddenly, one of the tourists screamed “Ouch!” and touched their arm. “I think something stung me just now.”

[h1][i]The Challenge[/i][/h1]

[b]Defeat 25 opponents[/b] in a mode of your choice on [b]Suora by apple2018[/b], and earn yourself the [b]Bee Wings (30 days)[/b]!

notes.title: Easter Story Contest
notes.content:
[img]http://w4.cdn.brick-force.com/uploads/teaser/image_550c5b2a1d363.jpeg?b65693de557c3[/img]

Easter is coming! In addition to ambitious map building contests which will start next week, we also want to challenge the most eloquent ones amongst you. Therefore our community team is hosting an Easter story contest in which you can prove that you have what it takes to be an excellent Brick-Writer!

[h1]Your Easter Story[/h1]

Write an Easter story that takes place in the Brick-World. What the story will be about is all up to you. However, there is an additional sneaky challenge that you must master. From each of the following points, you need to choose one theme that will occur in your story (the order of the terms in your story doesn’t matter):
[list]
colorfully painted Easter egg | broken, rotten Easter egg
squirrelly bunny | crabby bunny
four-bricked clover | drunken piggy
defect Easter egg grenade | square-egg shooting Easterbrick-Gun
excited child in a Brick Ranger costume | grumpy grandma
[/list]
[h1]Runtime[/h1]

You can submit your stories on our forums until 06.04.2015, 23:59 CET. The winners will be announced by 07.04.2015.

[h1]Rules[/h1]

The story you submit has to be your own work. Players who copy from other texts are disqualified from winning prizes. Your story should contain at least 350 words, but should also not be longer than 750 words. Take care not to use any insulting, condescending, or generally inappropriate expressions.
Tip: Stories full of errors do not read well and could be unintelligible. Your chances of winning are much higher when you pay attention to spelling and grammar. Microsoft Word and many websites offer good spell checkers which you can use for your texts.

[h1]Prizes[/h1]

Of course, your creativity will be rewarded:
[list]
[*]First place wins 3000 Tokens
[*]Second place wins 2500 Tokens
[*]Third place wins 2000 Tokens

All other eligible entries will be rewarded with [b]3 Pick`N´Win-Coins.[/b]

notes.title: Map of the Week: RockySnipe by Didavi
notes.content:
[img]http://w3.cdn.brick-force.com/uploads/teaser/image_54f600b0e1feb.png?b65693de557c3[/img]

[h1]The Map[/h1]

Eons ago, when the old Brickgods Brodin and Bhor still reigned over this world, a very powerful king decided to build himself an enormous castle. But as it was as large as a city, soon, its inhabitants started to fight amongst each other, as all brick people do when lots of them live together in limited space. They were fighting day in, day out, until finally, one fraction settled down in the Northern half, and the other in the Southern half of the castle.

[img]https://static4.brick-force.com/uploads/files/facebook_map_of_the_weekEN.png[/img]

A brittle peace followed… until some troublemakers decided it was time to once again dig up the old arguments. Brodin and Bhor had about enough. The earth suddenly opened up and ripped the mighty castle in two halves. Many of its inhabitants died when this happened, and afterwards, nobody dared to anger the gods again. One after the next, they left this cursed place.

For centuries now, the ruin has been deserted. Its past inhabitants are long forgotten, as are Brodin and Bhor. Seems like just the right time to once again dig up the old arguments…

[h1]The Challenge[/h1]

[b]Defeat the enemy team 3 times[/b] in a mode of your choice on RockySnipe by Didavi and earn yourself the [b]King’s Crown[/b] (30 days), to reign over RockySnipe in the future!

[b]End[/b]: Sunday, 8 March 2015, 23:59 CET.

notes.title: Map of the Week: BigChess by sniper_mrk
notes.content:
[img]http://w2.cdn.brick-force.com/uploads/teaser/image_54b577491d000.png?89ae201d77bb6[/img]

[h1] The Map [/h1]

“Another one of those cowboys… did you hear about it?” The barmaid was sitting down with her guests and whispered so that nobody else knew what she was saying. “The Sheriff caught one a few days ago. He had taken a whole box of our best bourbon and was strapping it to his horse’s back as he was caught! Damn rascal! I hope he’ll rot in prison for a while.”

Life in prison was everything but comfortable, and there was absolutely nothing to do. Not much crime happened in Brick County so currently, the cowboy was the only prisoner the Sheriff had, and they were both bored out of their minds. One day, he suggested to his prisoner that he would let him go if he played a few rounds of chess against him and won.

[img]https://static4.brick-force.com/uploads/files/facebook_EN_4.png[/img]

"Well then”, said the cowboy and took a last draw from his cigar before throwing it on the dirty cell floor to put it out. "If you really dare to challenge me…"

[h1]The Challenge[/h1]

Win 3 matches on BigChess by sniper_mrk and earn yourself the Thief’s Bunch of Keys (30 days) to get out of prison!

[b]End[/b]: Sunday, 18 January 2015, 23:59 CET
